findings.name: Disabled Veteran's Property/Vehicle Tax Exemption
findings.description: Nevada offers a tiered property (or vehicle governmental services tax) exemption to resident veterans with a permanent service-connected disability of at least 60%, who received an honorable discharge or certificate of satisfactory service. For the 2025/2026 fiscal year, the exemption reduces assessed value by $17,700 for a 60-79% rating, $26,550 for an 80-99% rating, and $35,400 for a 100% rating. The exemption may be applied to real property tax owed the following year, or alternatively applied toward the Governmental Services Tax when registering a vehicle with the DMV. Benefits may pass to the surviving spouse of a disabled veteran who was eligible at time of death.
otherReqs: Nevada Driver's License or Nevada ID card
DD-214, honorable discharge paper, or certificate of satisfactory service
VA or Armed Forces documentation of permanent service-connected disability percentage
Annual renewal via signed Exemption Renewal Post Card after initial approval
findings.agency: County Assessor's Office / Nevada Department of Taxation
documentation: VA documentation of permanent service-connected disability percentage
findings.sourceExcerpt: 60%-79%: $17,700 assessed value. 80%-99%: $26,550 assessed value. 100%: $35,400 assessed value. The exemption benefits may succeed to the surviving spouse of the disabled veteran who was eligible for the exemption at the time of death.

findings.name: Disabled Veteran License Plate
findings.description: Nevada issues Disabled Veteran (and Disabled Female Veteran) license plates to veterans with a qualifying service-connected disability. The plates display the International Symbol of Accessibility, enabling ADA parking access, and exempt the vehicle from Nevada state and local parking fees. Initial fee is $8.50 with no annual renewal fee. Applicants must apply in person with the SP10 application form (and SP27 if also requesting an accessibility placard).
findings.value: $8.50 initial fee, no renewal fee; exempt from state/local parking fees
otherReqs: Must apply in person at a Nevada DMV office
findings.form: SP10 (Disabled Veteran License Plate Application); SP27 (Disabled Persons Plates/Placards Application, if applicable)
findings.sourceExcerpt: Veterans with a qualifying service-connected disability. Enables ADA parking access via the International Symbol of Accessibility. Exempts vehicle from Nevada state and local parking fees. Initial: $8.50. Renewal: $0.

findings.name: Disabled Veteran Combination Hunting & Fishing License
findings.description: Nevada resident veterans with a service-connected disability of 50% or more, who received an honorable discharge or certificate of satisfactory service, are eligible for a specialty combination hunting and fishing license for $15, valid for one year from purchase. Applicants must attach a Benefit Summary/Percentage Letter from the VA certifying the disability rating along with discharge paperwork, and apply through the Nevada Department of Wildlife (NDOW) online system or an NDOW license agent.
findings.value: $15 annual combination hunting and fishing license
otherReqs: Service-connected disability rating of 50% or more
Honorable discharge or certificate of satisfactory service
VA Benefit Summary/Percentage Letter required as proof
documentation: VA Benefit Summary/Percentage Letter showing 50%+ service-connected disability
findings.sourceExcerpt: Resident veterans of the Armed Forces who have incurred a service-connected disability of 50% or more and have received an honorable discharge or certificate of satisfactory service are eligible for a specialty combination hunting and fishing license for $15.

findings.name: State Employment Veterans' Preference
findings.description: Under NRS 284.260, Nevada grants additional credit points on state civil-service examination scores for veterans, prioritized in tiers: veterans with a service-connected disability receive the highest preference, followed by veterans generally, then widows/widowers of service members killed in the line of duty, Nevada National Guard/Reserve members, and widows/widowers of veterans. These preference tiers cannot be combined — an applicant receives the highest tier for which they qualify. Service-connected disabled veterans who meet minimum position qualifications are guaranteed an interview, and at least 22% of applicants interviewed for a state position must be qualified veterans.
findings.value: Tiered additional credit on state civil-service exam scores; guaranteed interview for qualified service-connected disabled veterans
otherReqs: Preference tiers cannot be combined; highest-qualifying tier applies
Documentation per the Veteran Definition and Documentation Guide required
findings.agency: Nevada Department of Administration, Division of Human Resource Management
documentation: DD-214 or proof of veteran/disabled veteran status
findings.sourceExcerpt: Eligible categories: Veterans with service-connected disability (highest preference), Veterans, Widows/Widowers of those killed in line of duty, Reserves or Nevada National Guard members, Widows/Widowers of Veterans. These preferences cannot be combined and individuals should be awarded the highest preference they qualify for.

findings.name: Nevada State Veterans Homes
findings.description: Nevada operates two state veterans homes: the Southern Nevada State Veterans Home in Boulder City (opened 2002, 180-bed award-winning facility, state-owned and state-operated with U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs support), serving eligible veterans, spouses, and Gold Star parents, and the Northern Nevada State Veterans Home in Sparks (opened 2019, 102,000 sq. ft. facility with 96 beds offering skilled nursing and rehabilitation services). Both provide skilled nursing, memory/Alzheimer's-dementia care, and rehabilitative services, and are operated by the Nevada Department of Veterans Services.
findings.value: Skilled nursing, memory care, and rehabilitative services at two state veterans homes
otherReqs: Southern Nevada home serves veterans, spouses, and Gold Star parents
Specific admission criteria set by NDVS, not detailed on the summary pages fetched this session
documentation: DD-214 or other proof of military service
